_doc: Measured speed of each job type on each card (P1c, docs/CLOUD_RUNBOOK.md RP-08/RP-09). A row is written by `runpod cost` from the pod's own units.json (cloud/speeds.py), never typed. Empty = not measured: pick_gpus then falls back to the SPEED estimate of runpod.py, or, for a card it does not know, to the slowest known speed times margin_unmeasured. P12a/P12b fill the first rows.

ltx_clip_s_per_clip.note: D-116 J2/J4: one LTX generation of 3-6 s (BP-172), measured on the step-3 route-test pod

qwen_asset_s_per_image.note: D-116: one Qwen-Image-2.1 + xworld_v2 asset or first frame, measured on the asset pod

blender_25d_s_per_frame_pc.note: D-116 J5: one 2.5D Blender frame on the creator's PC (RX 5700, EEVEE, D-113)
